truthBoundary: This contract defines schemas, synthetic test fixtures, and fail-closed linkage rules. It is not a dataset, compute approval, training run, checkpoint, benchmark, release, route, or AGI evidence record.

officialStandards.use: Origin, development, ownership, location, and change chronology
Risk, evaluation, documentation, and governance baseline
SHA-256 JWK thumbprint derivation for trusted Ed25519 public-key ids
OKP Ed25519 public JWK representation and public-key-only boundary
Built-in Ed25519 signature verification with a null algorithm parameter

immutability.hashInput: Every record field except recordHash, recursively sorted by object key
immutability.claimBoundary: The deterministic fixture chain demonstrates validator behavior only. It is not an RFC 8785 claim and is not model artifact evidence.

trustRoot.truthBoundary: The verifier is implemented with Node crypto, but no public approval key is configured. The repository file is an empty default only; an active root must enter through a separately governed external startup boundary. Repository-authored hashes, self-asserted verification fields, fixtures, and callback results cannot authorize a release.

replayProtection.truthBoundary: Cryptographic verification binds one approval envelope but does not execute a release. A future release executor must atomically reject reused attestation ids and stale release versions before side effects.

linkRules: evaluation-report resolves its run, checkpoint, and dataset ids
dataset-manifest binds an immutable dataset-card id and content hash
checkpoint-record binds an immutable model-card id and content hash
release-decision resolves dataset, compute, run, checkpoint, evaluation, model-card, and dataset-card ids and hashes
every recordHash matches canonical content and every previousRecordHash matches the prior record
an allow release requires accepted evidence and explicit human approval
an allow release also requires an Ed25519 signature over the domain-separated release payload from an active RFC 7638-identified trusted public key
release/evaluation/checkpoint/dataset reference arrays must exactly equal the records in the six-record chain and an allow subject must be the accepted checkpoint
humanApprovalRequiredFor: GitHub push, pull request, merge, or release
nextSafeActions: Validate the six schemas with Ajv 8 and semantic domain rules.
Keep model-card and dataset-card template hashes null until reviewed immutable card artifacts exist.
Keep all currentEvidence arrays empty until real independently verified records exist.
Use only synthetic fixture records under packages/evals/fixtures for regression tests.
Keep the public-key trust root empty until the human owner approves an external release authority and key lifecycle policy.
Implement an atomic attestation-id and latest-release ledger before any release executor is introduced.
Require an exact human-approved run manifest before any real compute request.
